response.sql:
WITH rental_payment_totals AS (
  SELECT r.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS payment_total
  FROM rental r
  JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  JOIN payment p ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
  GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id
), above_average_rentals AS (
  SELECT rental_id, store_id, payment_total,
         AVG(payment_total) OVER () AS average_payment_total
  FROM rental_payment_totals
)
SELECT store_id,
       SUM(payment_total) AS combined_payment_total,
       AVG(payment_total - average_payment_total) AS average_amount_above_average
FROM above_average_rentals
WHERE payment_total > average_payment_total
GROUP BY store_id;

assumptions.assumption: The comparison average is across rental-level totals for all rentals with at least one linked payment; the requested store average is the mean excess among that store’s above-average rentals. Rentals without linked payments are excluded.
